# FunctionKit

Repository: https://github.com/TheTechclip/FunctionKit
npm: @musecat/functionkit

FunctionKit is a product-neutral React/Web utility library. The npm package publishes the public Web graph only. `web/musecat/**` is private application code and must never be suggested as a public import.

Primary docs:
- README.md — English overview
- README.ko.md — Korean overview
- docs/en/getting-started.md
- docs/en/api.md
- docs/en/runtime.md
- docs/en/recipes.md
- docs/en/migration-v2.md
- docs/en/releases.md
- docs/ko/ — Korean equivalents
- publicApi.manifest.json — complete generated public symbol inventory
- references/ — exact symbol contracts, defaults, runtime constraints, errors, cleanup, and examples

Public imports:
- @musecat/functionkit
- @musecat/functionkit/web

Do not recommend physical deep imports such as web/packages/... .
